beats.text: Here is the summit, with the storm all around, honeyed under a clear sky, the hour still late afternoon. Somewhere in it, a leaderless crowd — small, insistent, meant for you.

beats.speaker: Sefa
beats.text: Sefa tells you: "Here is what nobody told me about the wish to find your purpose: how heavy a gift is."

beats.speaker: Veil
beats.text: Veil tells you: "I am only what you buried."
At a leaderless crowd the thing you feared turns to face you, and it knows your name.

beats.speaker: Sefa
beats.text: Sefa, who first met you earlier on the road, is here again where it is hardest. "I said we'd meet once more. You already carry what you need — use it."

beats.speaker: Veil
beats.text: Veil steps out of the dark and, this time, does not move aside. "No more going around me. Whatever you do next, you do it facing me."
Someone nearby does the unexpected, and the moment tilts.

beats.text: A symbol points beyond itself; do not mistake the finger for the moon.
